<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Retract path and move UP to reach Blue
# First retract with LEFT
result = action(['LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
# Check path extent
max_col = 0
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['w', 'g']:
        b = n['boundary']
        c_max = max(p[1] for p in b)
        if c_max > max_col:

print("\n=== Key objects ===")
for n in seg2['nodes']:
    b = n['boundary']
    r_min, r_max = min(p[0] for p in b), max(p[0] for p in b)
    c_min, c_max = min(p[1] for p in b), max(p[1] for p in b)
    if n['color'] in ['M', 'R', 'b', 'N'] and r_min < 50:
        print(f"  {n['color']}: rows {r_min}-{r_max}, cols {c_min}-{c_max}")
